Council Meetings 

Council meetings start at 7pm and are held in Council Chambers.

Prior to each meeting, a Public Forum will be held at 6pm to allow interested parties to address the Councillors, on agenda items only.

You can attend a Public Forum, Council meeting or watch the meeting online via our YouTube livestream.

Watch a Council meeting or Public Forum online

The webcast of meetings is not, and shall not, be taken to be an official record of North Sydney Council or of any meeting or discussion depicted therein. North Sydney Council does not accept liability for any defamatory remarks or inappropriate comments that might be made during the course of a meeting. Recordings of meetings are copyright protected and cannot be reused or reproduced without approval from Council.

Council agendas, reports, minutes, and meeting dates can be found below. The business papers for an upcoming meeting are available to view on the Friday two weeks prior to the meeting.

To check a Council decision, refer to the Council meeting minutes for the resolution, usually available to view by 5pm on the Thursday following the meeting.

If you would like to address Council at a Public Forum (on agenda items only), please complete the form below by 10am on the day of the meeting.

Address Council at a Public Forum

Council has established a Section 10A Committee which will provide a structured forum for the detailed consideration of matters that may be dealt with in closed sessions. Learn more here.
